questions.title: Add a Column Correctly
questions.description: Which statement correctly adds a column allergens TEXT to the cakes table?

questions.Option2: ALTER cakes ADD COLUMN allergens TEXT;

questions.title: DROP vs DELETE
questions.description: Which statement empties a table's rows but keeps the table itself?
questions.Option1: DROP TABLE t; — it removes rows only
questions.Option2: DELETE FROM t; — the table definition stays
questions.Option3: DELETE FROM t; — it removes the table too
questions.Option4: Neither statement can empty a table

questions.title: CTAS Semantics

questions.Option1: An error — AS requires a column list
questions.Option2: A copy of breads' full original schema
questions.Option3: A new table archive with exactly the columns the SELECT returns
questions.Option4: An empty table with no columns

questions.title: ADD COLUMN NOT NULL Rule
questions.description: In SQLite, ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN x INTEGER NOT NULL is only allowed when…
questions.Option3: Never — NOT NULL columns cannot be added
questions.codesnippet:
ALTER TABLE cakes
  ADD COLUMN slices INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8;
